gate: G5 Stage 1 - EgoStitch E2E stable conditioned-encoder screen
version_boundary: Prospective post-v1 replacement. The v1 BINDING file and artifacts are immutable; this v2 registration is informed only by v1 train/validation diagnostics and no v1 candidate-score or held-out G5 gate result existed.

predecessor.execution_boundary: full-arm training pipeline completed; remaining arms, candidate scoring, and formal G5 gate were not run
predecessor.observed_training_failure: selected checkpoint was a reconstruction-only warm-start epoch; later joint training exhibited collapsed validation logits and non-finite fixed-probe edge-family gradients

scope: single-seed engineering screen only; no statistical-significance or cross-seed-robustness claim

claims.primary: A numerically valid E2E topology-conditioned encoder improves assembled-graph topology over calibrated independent scoring without more than the registered 0.02 AUPRC degradation.
claims.supporting: The topology pathway, rather than only pair/content capacity, contributes materially to any observed clustering-MMD gain.
claims.anti_claim: A random, collapsed, warm-start-only, or numerically unstable checkpoint cannot count as evidence for or against the architecture.

training_contract.mixed_precision: bf16 with fp32 Sinkhorn, gated-residual accumulation, logits, BCE, and finite checks

edge_sampler.normalization: sum of effective per-row weights over the exact global DDP batch

pair_encoder_head.schedule: linear warmup then cosine to 1e-5 at T

generator.schedule: linear warmup then cosine to 1e-5 at T

topology_content_conditioning.schedule: base cosine schedule multiplied by alpha; zero in Phase A

optimizer_groups.membership: disjoint and exhaustive sorted parameter-name manifests with SHA-256 in run metadata

training_contract.step_order: scaled backward -> BF16 unscale -> DDP reduction -> fp64 norm and finite check -> per-group clip -> optimizer step -> parameter and optimizer-state finite check

curriculum.name: dual_track_warmstart
curriculum.objective: L_recon plus class-balanced L_edge(f_logit); topology/content hard-bypassed; L_real and L_ssl off

curriculum.name: conditioning_ramp
curriculum.objective: full-logit L_edge and L_recon at full weight; conditioning-group LR and L_real/L_ssl weights multiplied by alpha

curriculum.name: full_joint
curriculum.objective: complete §13.5 objective and registered branch masks at full weight

training_contract.weighted_bce_ddp: m_i=real-row mask (zero on DDP padding); w_i=5*y_i+(1-y_i); D=all_reduce_sum(sum_local m_i*w_i); rank loss=world_size*sum_local(m_i*w_i*BCE_i)/D; exact with tail batches

stability_guards.measurement: each step: replicated DDP-averaged per-group norm from fp64 local sum with cross-rank equality assertion; fixed replay every 50 steps: isolated active-family x shared-group norms
immediate_abort: non-finite gradient element, optimizer-group norm, family norm, or submodule RMS
persistent_abort: any optimizer-group clip coefficient below 0.1 for 10 consecutive steps
within a shared optimizer group, max active-family norm divided by median active-family norm above 50 for four consecutive fixed probes after alpha reaches 1; inactive/null families excluded
fixed stability-split pair-logit std below max(0.25 times warm-start-end reference, 1e-4) for two consecutive validations
stability_guards.reference_validity: warm-start-end pair-logit std is measured after the final Phase-A update in eval mode and must be finite and >=1e-4
stability_guards.binding_margin: healthy rehearsal: clip coefficient p1>0.12, minimum>0.0012, longest consecutive run below 0.1 is <10 steps; per-group family-ratio p99<40
stability_guards.abort_consequence: synchronous invalid run; publish failure metadata only; no best.pt, complete.json, candidate score, or gate input
stability_guards.last_checkpoint: diagnostic-only under failure-specific directory; never eligible for formal scoring

checkpoint_selection.first_eligible_time: after the conditioning ramp and one complete full-joint epoch

validation_contract.split_rule: after E_msg derivation, create V_qual as deterministic 256-node BFS from largest G_msg component with seed/frontier hash prefix g5-v2-qual|; remove it and create V_select identically with g5-v2-select|; component ties use sorted node-id tuple; V_fit is the remainder; train only on induced E_msg[V_fit] and E_sup pairs inside V_fit; quarantine cross-partition edges
validation_contract.aggregation: complete global manifest after exact DDP gather; fp32 average_precision_score on binary labels
validation_contract.warm_reference: measure after final Phase-A update on applicable complete pair manifest; rehearsal may open only V_qual, first bound run opens untouched V_select; runtime collapse uses fixed applicable slice
validation_contract.fit_manifest: REQUIRED-BEFORE-BINDING: V_fit, E_msg[V_fit], E_sup[V_fit], quarantined cross-bucket counts, and SHA-256 values
validation_contract.qualification_manifest: REQUIRED-BEFORE-BINDING: V_qual, complete non-self pairs, labels and gold graph from E_msg[V_qual] only, prevalence, exact-gold-density assembly, metric config, and SHA-256 values
validation_contract.checkpoint_manifest: REQUIRED-BEFORE-BINDING: untouched V_select counterpart with the same fields plus zero node/label-edge overlap proof
validation_contract.topology_metric: raw biased squared MMD between the single exact-gold-density predicted-graph and gold-graph clustering-coefficient histograms, using pinned existing histogram bins and RBF-kernel configuration; not the external multi-reference normalized MMD ratio; checkpoint selection only, never external held-out evidence

full_and_p0_eligibility: all finite and gradient guards pass for the epoch
checkpoint_selection.liveness_preflight: registered conjunctive rule is still recorded; residual eligibility already excludes its <1e-5 death branch
checkpoint_selection.pair_topology_eligibility: finite/gradient guards; std(pair_topology)>=1e-4; AUPRC(pair_topology)>=label prevalence+0.02; active topology-conditioning fixed-replay gradient norm >=1e-8
checkpoint_selection.selection: among eligible epochs within 0.02 AUPRC of the best eligible epoch for that arm, minimize train-side validation clustering MMD
checkpoint_selection.tie_break: lower unweighted validation Brier score, then earlier epoch
forbidden: fallback to a checkpoint that violates any eligibility condition

overfit_test.selection: 85 E_sup[V_fit] positives with smallest sha256(canonical_pair) and 425 deterministic registered-sampler negatives with both endpoints in V_fit, fixed Seed 0; canonical-pair manifest created once before sharding and invariant to rank/world size; cycle fixed rows

prebinding_qualification.full_arm_rehearsal: exact 30-epoch full-arm config on 2 x H20 using only qualification pair/topology manifests; eligible post-ramp checkpoint required; checkpoint-selection manifests remain unread; no stability guard may fire
prebinding_qualification.attempt_policy: at most three disclosed full-arm rehearsal attempts; first pass freezes implementation/config; fourth attempt or any later scientific/optimization change requires v3
prebinding_qualification.precision_test: end-ramp and selected checkpoints, eval mode, same replay identities and hard masks; BF16+fp32 islands versus pure fp32 at registered elementwise and residual-vector tolerances
prebinding_qualification.boundary_audit: qualification data root omits candidate/test manifests and test_graph.pkl; grounding universes are separately hashed as train=V_fit, rehearsal=V_qual, formal internal selection=V_select, external=test side; access log proves training endpoints subset V_fit, no V_qual/V_select/V_test feature row is read by a training step, G_fit digest equals loop-stripped E_msg[V_fit], heldout E_msg[V_qual]/E_msg[V_select] and E_sup/validation positives never enter topology-training targets, and no candidate/test score or assembly; global-positive rejection may use validation-positive membership only to prevent false negatives and is identical across arms
required_binding_evidence: exact config paths and SHA-256 values for all four training arms
optimizer parameter-name manifests and SHA-256 values
overfit and full-arm rehearsal artifact SHA-256 values
all qualification attempt config/result SHA-256 values and boundary access log
selected checkpoint policy fields in run metadata

execution_order: qualify and bind v2 without held-out access
run full-arm checkpoint-eligibility and validation liveness preflight
stop the experiment if full is invalid
require eligible checkpoints and matching registration/config hashes for every arm
produce the representation probe and run the formal G5 evaluator
comparator_note: carried over from the frozen-s0 screen; b0_cal_selfdensity is the empirically strongest arm there and remains the bar

candidate_manifest.identity_rule: every scored artifact must match row count, canonical pair order, labels, self-pair mask, and manifest SHA-256 exactly

b0cal_results.lineage: REQUIRED-BEFORE-BINDING: restore immutable local deliverable and pin source checkout, commit, checkpoint, and row-count lineage

operating_point.canonical: density-matched threshold on non-self candidate rows against target_edges = |E(strip_self_loops(test))|
operating_point.matched: per comparator, realize its exact non-self edge quota by descending pass-1 score with the registered deterministic boundary tie-break

criteria: clustering-MMD ratio strictly lower than every comparator at the canonical operating point
BFS-macro GS strictly higher than every comparator at that comparator's matched-global-RD quota
BFS-macro RD strictly higher than every comparator at the same matched quota

pathway_attribution.metric: clustering_mmd_ratio at the canonical operating point
pathway_attribution.rule: formal pass requires G_full > 0 and G_pt >= 0.25 * G_full
pathway_attribution.reading_on_fail: if G_full<=0, no gain is established relative to matched f-only; if G_full>0 but the share fails, topology contribution is insufficient and the headline is withdrawn

structure_control_condition.rule: paired bootstrap over 500 fixed evaluation subgraphs with shared resample indices, B=1000, seed=0; require 2.5th percentile of clu(structure_control_6a)-clu(full) > 0
structure_control_condition.scope: fixed-training-seed evaluator sampling stability only, not cross-seed inference
structure_control_condition.reading_on_fail: the registered control did not establish that intact relational connectivity is necessary beyond retained topology-derived node features

liveness_within_checkpoint.death_rule: residual ratio <1e-5 AND Spearman(full,f_logit)>0.9999 AND top-1% overlap>0.9999
liveness_within_checkpoint.consequence: run-validity failure before held-out topology metrics

e2e_rules.four_logit_decomposition: full, f_logit, pair_content, and pair_topology per scored pair for every scored arm/artifact, fp32, provenance egostitch_e2e_pair_fp32_v1, per-array resolution guard; diagnostic only

diagnostics_nonbinding: linear probes on frozen STE token states with degree-partialled variants and Pi consistency
gate tanh magnitudes, optimizer-group norms, family-by-shared-group norms, and gradient cosines
p0-vs-full four-logit divergence and unweighted BCE/Brier/ECE

probe_artifact.source_binding: arms.full.training with permanent_null=none and p_topo=p_cont=0.15; p0 is rejected
probe_artifact.node_selection: all operative train nodes, sorted id order
probe_artifact.pair_selection: 4096 non-self E_msg pairs with smallest sha256(canonical_pair), or all if fewer

cost_report.requirement: measured 2 x H20 v2 profile: step wall, peak memory, exact 30-epoch full-arm runtime, per-arm projection, and five-pass candidate scoring estimate

predecessor_observation.scope: v1 planning context only; not v2 qualification

cost_report.v2_measured: REQUIRED-BEFORE-BINDING: structured paths, SHA-256 values, hardware, runtime, peak memory, and budget margins

verdict_rule: pass iff every training arm is valid, full passes all primary criteria and both guards, liveness passes, G_full>0, attribution share passes, and structure control passes; training invalid precedes scientific verdict, otherwise failures are multi-label cut reasons

failure_reading.training_invalid: The registered optimization process did not produce a numerically valid and eligible checkpoint; no architecture-level held-out conclusion is permitted.
failure_reading.primary_fail: The stable topology-conditioned encoder does not beat calibrated independent scoring at this stage.
failure_reading.guard_fail: The model exceeded the registered edge-ranking degradation or degree-MMD guard.
failure_reading.attribution_fail: No gain over matched f-only was established, or the topology share was insufficient; withdraw the topology-representation headline.
failure_reading.structure_control_fail: The registered control did not establish that intact relational connectivity is necessary beyond retained topology-derived node features at this fixed seed.
failure_reading.classification_order: training_invalid first and no scientific verdict; otherwise report every applicable primary_fail, guard_fail, attribution_fail, and structure_control_fail label and return cut if any is present

binding_acceptance_tests: phase boundaries, complete coverage, world-size invariance, and first-eligible timing
1-GPU/2-GPU weighted-BCE gradient equivalence including tail batch
parameter-group disjointness/exhaustiveness and frozen Kendall scalars
synchronous abort and no success artifacts for injected finite/clip/collapse failures
arm-specific checkpoint eligibility, topology-aware selection, deterministic tie-break, and no fallback
precision replay at end-ramp and selected checkpoints
file/node access audit and candidate scorer provenance rejection
required_before_binding: REQUIRED-BEFORE-BINDING: implement and test every docs/05-egostitch-spec.md §13.19 training, precision, finite-check, checkpoint-eligibility, and publication rule
REQUIRED-BEFORE-BINDING: enforce the DRAFT/debug candidate/test scoring prohibition and validate structured binding_evidence before DDP
REQUIRED-BEFORE-BINDING: create the four v2 config files and pin their SHA-256 values
REQUIRED-BEFORE-BINDING: create and hash disjoint validation and train-side topology-selection manifests
REQUIRED-BEFORE-BINDING: complete the deterministic overfit test and 2 x H20 full-arm train/validation rehearsal in a no-test-mounted data root
REQUIRED-BEFORE-BINDING: record implementation commit, parameter groups, packs, validation manifests, every qualification attempt, access audit, artifact digests, measured runtime, and peak memory
REQUIRED-BEFORE-BINDING: independent review confirms JSON/prose parity and no v1 artifact is relabeled as v2 evidence

mechanics.formal_worker: before DDP, reject status other than BINDING, any REQUIRED-BEFORE-BINDING marker, invalid binding_evidence schema, missing artifact, non-64-hex digest, live hash mismatch, config path not equal to arms.<arm>.training, or parameter/pack/qualification mismatch
mechanics.debug_worker: DRAFT accepted only with explicit debug mode; outputs isolated and forbidden as held-out/gate inputs
mechanics.candidate_scorer: egostitch_e2e candidate/test scoring requires registration path, run metadata, BINDING status, formal+complete+eligible status, and exact registration/config/checkpoint hashes; DRAFT/debug is train/validation-only
mechanics.gate: requires this registration SHA-256 and exact config SHA-256 in every formal run metadata plus the provenance-bound probe artifact
mechanics.amendment: any post-binding optimizer, schedule, precision, guard, eligibility, scientific, or frozen-input change requires a new versioned registration
